value.rationale: The source reports only the globally balanced product optimum. The conditional frontier answers the natural quantitative question of how much inverse-regular control the same positive construction guarantees under a prescribed forward budget. It gives every optimal parameter triple, a sharp mechanism switch at R=3, the asymptotic inverse-guarantee floor 2, and the balanced constant as the unique product-optimal point. This is a complete structural profile of the source construction rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
